items.raw_excerpt: Denmark is known for its crafts. From beautiful furniture to famous architecture, and a history of knitting and clothing design, creativity is greatly encouraged in Denmark. For that reason it isn't typically difficult to come across courses to improve your skills. We’ve compiled a list of our favourites.
items.summary_en: The Local Denmark has compiled a list of hobby courses available in Copenhagen this autumn. The city offers a variety of creative workshops and classes for residents looking to learn new skills. From crafting to design, there are many options to explore.

items.raw_excerpt: From singing certain lines of the national anthem to sending birthday greetings on the wrong day, there are many ways to make yourself unpopular in Germany.
items.summary_en: A lighthearted list of common cultural missteps in Germany, such as singing the national anthem wrong or forgetting someone's birthday. The article points out everyday customs that can easily irritate Germans. It offers a fun look at unwritten social rules in German life.

items.raw_excerpt: Auckland's Motat says the working Trekka - driveable and in mostly original condition - came from Blenheim and had spent at least 20 years in Otago.
items.summary_en: A driveable Trekka, New Zealand's only locally produced car, has arrived at Auckland's MOTAT museum. The mostly original vehicle came from Blenheim and spent over 20 years in Otago.
